protocol.implementation_adapter: Provide empty trace metadata when the existing non-partitioned trainer omits trace keys expected by the undefined-match retention path; no numeric or matching changes.
not_claims: Seeds, capacity variants, cells and specimens are not new biological patients.
All fits reuse the full discovery gene panel, cell QC and supplied patient/lineage mapping.
Full-discovery topic fitting is not independent held-patient or external-cohort validation.
Assigned, weak, negative, unmatched and undefined matches remain in the tables without a success threshold.
The rowwise best match is a labeled sensitivity diagnostic and never replaces the Hungarian primary match.
Fixed 40000-step completion is not proof of optimizer convergence.
Density comparisons are descriptive transformed-score likelihoods, not proof of discrete biological states.
No new healing, amputation, MCID, mechanistic or prognostic hypothesis test is performed.
No GitHub publishing, commits, releases, installations, software archives or raw-data duplication.
protocol.question: Describe topic and measurement sensitivity across a fixed capacity/seed grid on the existing discovery cohort, retaining every missing or adverse match.

stage_gate.sidecar_hold_verbatim: Do not start real experiments until protocol is written and tested and report is submitted to leader for review; send concise readiness with files/command/plan job count. Main will authorize run after review via send_input.
stage_gate.user_authorization_verbatim: I approve you, I allow you, I proceed you with more experiments, with more methods, with more data sets, and any way that you can find to improve the current version of the papers, of the directions.
